newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: FORECAST - Good demand seen for Portugal 3-yr bonds.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Good demand seen for Portugal 3-yr bonds.

text.p: Demand was seen strong for the 25 billion escudos of three year bonds being offered at auction by the Institute of Public Credit Management (IGCP) on Tuesday with yields dipping below secondary market levels, traders said.

Yields were seen between 5.80 and 5.90 percent for the March 2000 paper against the average rate of 5.8953 percent at the previous such sale on March 11 when the Institute placed 19.75 billion escudos. The paper closed at 5.88 percent on the secondary market on Monday.
The result will be announced around 1100 GMT.

Traders said the strong demand and slightly lower yields would be triggered by the renewed optimism that Europe's single currency would be launched on time, expectations for a rate cut by the Bank of Portugal and the strength of the escudo.

"You are not taking a big risk bidding near 5.80 percent because even at this level we are still five basis points above the (Spanish) Bono which is perfectly reasonable," said one analyst at an investment bank.
